title: ERPNext 15 POS invoice, POS Invoice format, custom 80 x 200 mm page, no letter head, 3 pages
notes: POS Invoice ACC-PSINV-2026-00001, submitted (Paid), 2026-10-23 11:42, customer "Client comptoir", 4 lines (CER-MUG-35 2 x 16.90, CER-BOL-12 4 x 14.50, CER-COU-14 3 x 8.90, CER-VAS-20 1 x 22.00), net 140.50 EUR, VAT 20 % 28.10, total 168.60, paid 200.00 in cash, change 31.40. Print Settings: PDF page size Custom, width 80 mm, height 200 mm (a receipt roll); other settings as the defaults. No letter head: "No Letterhead" chosen in the print view (`no_letterhead=1`). Captured from Frappe 15.124.0 (commit f1cf50cf9bbc) + ERPNext 15.124.1 (commit 4e0dce9ea8d3), printed through HTTP /api/method/frappe.utils.print_format.download_pdf with a logged-in session, as the print view's PDF button does. Frappe (pdfkit 1.0.0) pipes the page on stdin and reads the PDF from stdout: `-` `-` at the end; the output `-` is replaced by {out}. Frappe passed `--cookie-jar /tmp/<random>.jar` (session cookie sid); that pair is removed. The page has no #header-html / #footer-html block, so Frappe passes no header or footer page and adds `--margin-top 15mm --margin-bottom 15mm`; there are no page numbers. Origin http://127.0.0.1:8000 rewritten to http://127.0.0.1:8765 in input/page.html (no www/ file contained it). www lists the entry's own files (if any) then corpus/_shared/erpnext15/www (print CSS print.bundle.7DKZWKDD.css, same content as H34JAH53 of the first two ERPNext entries but for three comments, and the Atelier Kiln logo). httpHeaders are the Cache-Control values the Frappe server sent. The print CSS has no @font-face: the text relies on fonts installed on the machine. ERPNext parts are GPL-3.0; Frappe parts are MIT; the print CSS also bundles Bootstrap 3.3.1, normalize.css and HTML5 Boilerplate (MIT) and Quill 2.0.3 CSS (BSD-3-Clause); letter heads, images and business data were written for the corpus. See SOURCE.md.
